address: 44 route de l'Eure, Les Damps, 27340, France
bio: The name may evoke Normandy and its apples, and it may have a half-timbered façade that is typical of the region, but that's where the cliché ends! Inside you will encounter a very contemporary decor, with a bright dining area with large picture windows affording views out over the garden. The dishes, which showcase local producers, include carpaccio of scallops from Normandy, poached monkfish with a coulis of watercress from Cailly-sur-Eure, and farm-raised veal chop casserole....
